versions.changelog:
Initial skill release for structured inspection table recognition and analysis.

- Converts inspection record images (quality, equipment, or audit) into structured data and summary reports.
- Provides a closed-loop process: visual recognition → data structuring → merging & cleaning → analysis → outputs (Markdown report + CSV data).
- Enforces mandatory user review of low-confidence or unclear fields before analysis to prevent errors.
- Supports images from photos, scans, screenshots, or PDFs; multiple files handled in one batch.
- Delivers clear data analysis (pass rates, issues classification, trend, TOP problems) and integrates user confirmations throughout the workflow.
